candidate.user_submission: Pikin no dey convulse now. Dem never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e never unconscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed well. E no dey vomit everything wey e chop. The pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear wahala. E no get fever. Dem count the pikin breath for one full minute. E no get chest indrawing. When dem dey assess am, pikin calm. This cough don last for 15 days. Pulse oximeter no dey available. E no dey get recurrent wheeze. Dem count 35 breaths per minute. E no get stridor when e calm. E no dey wheeze.
